issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Busabase
products.tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
products.summaryZh: AI代理的通用记录系统
products.descriptionZh: 不同的智能体，同一个共享底座。Busabase 是面向人与 AI 智能体的通用数据库与工作空间。将业务记录、文档、技能和应用集中在一处，让下一项任务能够在此基础上继续构建。连接 Claude Code、Codex 等。设置访问权限，按需审查变更，并查看变更内容。Busabase 是开源的，提供 Cloud、Personal Desktop 和自托管选项。
products.description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

products.name: Zernio
products.tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
products.summaryZh: 面向产品和智能体的营销基础设施
products.descriptionZh: Zernio 是 20 万开发者构建产品所依托的营销基础设施。我们基于官方 API，承担每个渠道背后的集成、平台审批和维护工作，让你今天就能开始构建。一个 API 覆盖 16 个社交平台、7 个网络的广告、WhatsApp、iMessage，以及可在 Zernio 内购买、支持通话和短信的电话号码。你可以在代码中使用 REST API，也可以让你的编码代理通过我们的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 完成同样的操作。
products.description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

products.name: Playground by Google Labs
products.tagline: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI
products.summaryZh: 使用Google AI创建、游玩并分享你自己的游戏
products.descriptionZh: Google Playground 是一个实验性 AI 游戏平台，让任何人都能无需编程即可创建、游玩和分享自定义游戏。描述你的想法，选择一种类型，AI 便会在几分钟内构建出一款可玩的游戏。只需通过对话，就能修改规则、角色、物理效果或视觉画面。将你的创作分享给朋友，发布到社区画廊，或探索他人制作的游戏。由 Google 的 Gemini、Nano Banana 和 Lyria 模型提供支持。
products.description: Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

products.name: Together Link
products.tagline: Use open models in your harness
products.summaryZh: 在你的测试框架中使用开放模型
products.descriptionZh: Together Link 将编码代理连接到 Together AI 上的开放模型，让开发者保留现有工具和工作流程，同时降低模型成本。
products.description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

products.name: Odyssey 3
products.tagline: A world model that simulates physics in real time
products.summaryZh: 实时模拟物理的世界模型
products.descriptionZh: Odyssey-3 是一个基础世界模型，可根据提示生成交互式环境，并实时预测当你或智能体在其中行动时环境如何变化。其 Pro 版本公布了最高的 Physics-IQ Verified 视频到视频得分（66.1，best-of-8）。同一模型已被适配用于控制机械臂和人形机器人、驾驶汽车以及训练智能体。可试用研究预览版，或联系我们获取 API 访问权限。
products.description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

products.name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
products.tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
products.summaryZh: 在Gemini和Claude上均可运行的工作代理
products.descriptionZh: Gemini agent 是 Google Cloud 面向工作的单一通用智能体。给它一个目标，而非指令：它会自行规划，调用贵公司的技能与工具，连接 Workspace、Microsoft 365、Slack、Salesforce、Jira 或任意 MCP 服务器，并交付完成的文档、演示文稿或代码。与止步于给出答案的聊天助手不同，它能在云端持续运行数小时乃至数天，创建拥有独立邮箱和日历的协作智能体，并在严格的支出上限下将每项任务路由至合适的模型。
products.description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

products.name: Refs
products.tagline: Give Claude better references for your videos
products.summaryZh: 为你的视频给 Claude 提供更好的参考。
products.descriptionZh: Refs 是一个收录了 3000 多部打动过人的影片的库，每一部都逐镜拆解，并整理成含 15 张图版蓝图的说明，附带配方提示词。用一条命令把它添加到 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor，Claude 便会以真实影片为参照来规划你的发布影片。
products.description: Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

products.name: AgentSDR
products.tagline: Open-source AI SDR
products.summaryZh: 开源 AI SDR
products.descriptionZh: 开源 AI SDR 工作空间，可替代 Clay、Smartlead、HubSpot 等众多工具。运行邮件序列、LinkedIn 营销活动和 WhatsApp 外联，内置数据丰富和自动化功能，并由 AI CRM 支持，自动分类回复并起草响应。使用你自己的 AI 密钥进行自托管。
products.description: The open-source AI SDR workspace that replaces Clay, Smartlead, HubSpot, and many more. Run email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, and WhatsApp outreach with built-in data enrichment and automations, backed by an AI CRM that automatically classifies replies and drafts responses. Self-hosted with your own AI keys.

products.name: OpenPilot
products.tagline: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose
products.summaryZh: 开源桌面 AI 代理，支持任选模型
products.descriptionZh: OpenPilot 是一款免费、采用 MIT 许可证的桌面 AI 代理。连接任意兼容 OpenAI 的模型（OpenAI、OpenRouter、Ollama、LM Studio），选择一个文件夹，它便可在其中读取和编辑文件并运行命令。敏感操作需经你批准。现已支持 Windows，macOS 处于早期测试阶段。
products.description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

products.name: OpenVids
products.tagline: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents
products.summaryZh: 开源视频编辑器，通过与AI代理聊天来操作
products.descriptionZh: 开源、智能体优先的 AI 视频编辑器，适用于 macOS 和 Windows。描述影片——智能体剪辑时间线、添加动态和声音，并审查渲染结果。
products.description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

products.name: Pine Computer
products.tagline: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done
products.summaryZh: 为完成工作而构建的AI云计算机
products.descriptionZh: Pine Computer 是一台为 AI 使用而构建的云计算机。你的产品交给它一项任务：研究、表单、电子表格、没有 API 的门户网站。完成的工作会返回。AI 读取每个应用的结构而非像素，在发生变化时收到通知，并按需获得任意数量的虚拟屏幕。通过一个 SDK 为每位客户启动一台计算机，自带模型或使用我们的模型，并让人接管登录或审批。仅限邀请的测试版。
products.description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

products.name: BrightBean Studio
products.tagline: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams
products.summaryZh: 面向社交媒体团队的开源 Buffer 替代方案
products.descriptionZh: BrightBean Studio 是一款免费、开源的 Buffer 替代品，面向社交媒体团队、代理机构和小型企业。支持排期并发布至 10 多个平台，管理审批、分析和收件箱，并通过内置的 MCP 服务器和 REST API 连接 AI 代理。
products.description: BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

products.name: OpenCharm
products.tagline: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run
products.summaryZh: 为你已在运行的 AI 智能体提供开源主体
products.descriptionZh: OpenCharm 是一个开源机身，为你已经在运行的 AI 智能体而设，就位于 Mac 刘海旁。按住一个键说话，Claude Code、Codex 或任何智能体便开始工作，大声作答，并在需要你时发问。接下来，它挂在你的钥匙扣上。
products.description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

products.name: HeyPi
products.tagline: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings
products.summaryZh: 在会议中实时构建和交付任何内容
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI会议工具记录已发生的内容，然后给你发送笔记。HeyPi则实时跟进对话，记住当前及过往会议中的发言，在有用时私密地呈现关键信息，并在会议结束前就开始跨你的工具处理后续工作。Pi还能将你最大胆的产品和营销创意变为现实——落地页、应用、社交媒体内容、广告活动等都能在会议中实时生成。少一些AI笔记，多一些AI执行。
products.description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

products.name: Opposable
products.tagline: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs
products.summaryZh: 让手机具备计算机使用能力，为你的AI装上双手
products.descriptionZh: Opposable 让 Claude Code、Codex 或任何 MCP 代理能够查看、点击和输入到真实的 iPhone 或 Android 手机上，覆盖你已登录的所有应用。常见任务无需模型即可在手机上运行，支付等待你点击确认，iPhone 可通过蓝牙或一个小型 USB 棒连接。
products.description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

products.name: Melete
products.tagline: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace
products.summaryZh: 始终在线的个人代理，配备团队工作空间
products.descriptionZh: 认识Melete，你的个人代理，运行在你的硬件上。你越频繁使用AI，就越需要教导它。每次开启新对话都意味着要重新解释项目。Melete是一个拥有自己电脑的个人AI代理。它能记住你正在处理的工作，当你离开时继续推进未完成的任务，并能在几周后重新接手项目，无需从头开始。Melete Cloud现已开放等待名单注册。对于企业，我们正接纳少量试点团队。
products.description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

products.name: Phonable
products.tagline: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist
products.summaryZh: 未接来电，轻松处理：来电者收到短信，你了解大意
products.descriptionZh: Phonable 在 iPhone 上取代运营商语音信箱，修复未接来电两端的问题。未接来电后，来电者会收到一条短信，因此即使对方挂断且未留言，也知道你为何没能接听。你会收到要点：语音留言以转录文本形式送达，并附有简短的 AI 摘要。一键或按计划切换工作、驾驶或健身等模式，用你自己的声音或自然的 AI 声音问候来电者，并保留你自己的号码。
products.description: Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number.

products.name: Staffcoder
products.tagline: Build like a real engineer
products.summaryZh: 像真正的工程师一样构建
products.descriptionZh: Staffcoder 是一个动手实践的编程平台，开发者在这里练习真实的工程工作，而非算法谜题。提供 39 条学习路径中的 1000 多个挑战，涵盖 React、Next.js、Django、Spring Boot、Docker、Kubernetes、AI 智能体等。每个挑战都在完整的浏览器 IDE 中运行，配备真实终端、文件系统和实时预览，无需安装任何东西。选择技术栈，打开挑战，开始构建。免费起步。
products.description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

products.name: Amazon Alexa Tablets
products.tagline: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode
products.summaryZh: 完整的Google Play、Alexa+以及Kindle阅读模式
products.descriptionZh: Amazon Alexa 平板电脑是全新的 Android 产品线，完整支持 Google Play，并内置 Alexa+。提供 8.7 英寸、11 英寸和 12 英寸三种尺寸，带来屏幕上的 AI 辅助、实时对话、无干扰的 Kindle 阅读模式，12 Pro 还可选配 Nanomatte 显示屏。
products.description: Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.

products.name: Murmur
products.tagline: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts
products.summaryZh: 一款私密的语音优先记事本，记录你的想法
products.descriptionZh: Murmur 是一个私密、以语音为先的思绪记忆工具。用说话代替打字，Murmur 会把你转瞬即逝的想法变成可搜索的记忆。之后，你可以问自己当时在想什么，重新发现被遗忘的念头，或用 Future Capsules 把想法发送给未来的自己。没有信息流。没有关注者。只有你的想法，被记住。
products.description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.
